issue: Blocked task is entirely uneditable; description and priority cannot be changed
actual: On blocked task "Complete tax filing" (id 4), the edit button carries the HTML `disabled` attribute; clicking it times out ("element is not enabled") and no edit form opens. Enumerating all interactive controls in the blocked task card returned only: complete (disabled), edit (disabled), delete (enabled). There is no inline edit, no alternative affordance, so the required ability to still modify description and priority is absent — not merely the title/deadline fields being locked.
evidence: Card control scan: [complete disabled=true, edit disabled=true, delete disabled=false]

issue: Reopening a prerequisite leaves the dependent task simultaneously completed and blocked, and unrecoverable
actual: Completed task 4 "Complete tax filing" (prerequisite: task 1). Reopening task 1 was allowed with no warning or prompt. Afterwards task 4 stayed in the completed view and in the completed count (Completed 3), with complete toggle state="completed" and line-through styling, while ALSO showing the blocked warning 'Prerequisite "Review project proposal" incomplete'. The system neither prevented the reopen nor returned task 4 to an incomplete state. Worse, task 4 is now stuck: its complete toggle (disabled=true) and edit button (disabled=true) are both disabled, so the user cannot un-complete or edit it to resolve the contradiction — only Delete remains enabled.
evidence: tasks.list.item.4.complete → {state:"completed", enabled:false}; card text ends 'Prerequisite "Review project proposal" incomplete'; buttons: complete disabled, edit disabled, delete enabled.

Completing "Review project proposal" did not delete it — it persisted in the completed view with full details (title, priority, description, deadline) and an enabled delete button. Reopening it moved it back to the active list rather than destroying it (totals stayed at 8 tasks: 4+4 → 5+3).
